_doc: Every walkable map (design/ruins/tech-plan.md §1). path: its map.json; kit: which builders draw it (town: the camp's houses, stalls and lamps; ruin: broken walls, rubble, pillars, pits, cracks); name: shown on the loading card; story: its folder of .story files (the camp's is data/world/story/); mood: a fixed mood from data/visual.json world.moods (none: the camp's time of day); palette: colours over the town palette for this layer; fog_density: the mist, thicker in the ruin; clock: whether the time of day runs here.
